# USA Anime Club

> Independent US-focused anime culture publication with fan guides, free planning tools, press submissions, and transparent editorial policies.

USA Anime Club is an independent editorial website, not an official anime studio, publisher, streaming service, or convention organizer. Coverage focuses on helping readers in the United States make informed decisions about anime, manga, cosplay, events, community and access.

## Explore the website
- [US Anime Culture, Fan Guides & Press](https://usaanimeclub.com/): USA Anime Club is an independent US anime culture publication with practical fan guides, 23 free interactive tools, press submissions and community resources.
- [Anime & Manga Guides](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/): Explore US-focused anime and manga guides covering legal streaming, collecting, cosplay, conventions, community groups and accessibility.
- [23 Free Anime & Manga Tools for US Fans](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/): Browse 23 free anime tools for US fans, including convention planning, manga research, time zone conversion, watch parties and cosplay checklists.
- [Anime Press Releases & Story Submissions](https://usaanimeclub.com/press/): Submit an anime press release or story tip involving US screenings, manga publishers, conventions and creators. Review USA Anime Club's submission requirements.
- [About USA Anime Club](https://usaanimeclub.com/about/): Learn about USA Anime Club's independent editorial mission, US anime fan coverage, source verification process and approach to fan community reporting.

## Published anime and manga guides
- [Making Anime Viewing More Accessible: Captions, Devices and Watch Spaces](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/accessible-anime-viewing/): A practical accessibility checklist covering captions, readable interfaces, audio options and comfortable shared viewing.
- [Anime and Manga at Your Public Library: A US Reader's Guide](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/anime-manga-public-library/): Discover local manga, digital borrowing and community programs without assuming every library offers the same catalog.
- [Anime Seasons, Cours and Simulcasts: What Release Labels Actually Mean](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/anime-season-terms/): Understand release terms, episode counts and schedule language without mistaking marketing labels for a complete series.
- [Buying Anime Merchandise Safely in the US: A Fan's Checklist](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/buy-anime-merch-safely/): Check seller identity, listings, payment protections and authenticity signals before buying a figure, poster or collectible.
- [How to Choose Your First Anime Without Getting Overwhelmed](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/choose-first-anime/): Find an accessible starting series by mood, episode commitment and content preferences rather than internet rankings.
- [Cosplay on a Budget: Design, Safety and Convention Rules](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/cosplay-budget-safety/): A step-by-step approach to planning a first cosplay without wasting money or ignoring venue policies.
- [Dub or Sub? A More Useful Way to Choose Anime Audio](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/dub-or-sub/): Ignore the fandom argument and compare attention, translation, accessibility, setting and personal preference.
- [Fan Art, Credits and Permissions: A Practical Guide for Anime Fans](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/fan-art-permission-credit/): Understand attribution, reposting and US copyright basics without assuming that online artwork is free to reuse.
- [How to Find Where an Anime Streams Legally in the US](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/find-anime-streaming-us/): Use a repeatable search method that checks regional rights, seasons, audio tracks, subscriptions and purchase options.
- [Your First Anime Convention in the US: A Practical Field Guide](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/first-anime-convention/): Plan tickets, transit, spending, accessibility and your first convention schedule without turning it into a logistical marathon.
- [Hosting an Anime Watch Party: Rights, Captions and Comfort](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/host-anime-watch-party/): Build an enjoyable group viewing experience while taking screening permissions and accessibility seriously.
- [Manga Collecting on a Budget: A Guide for US Readers](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/manga-collecting-budget/): Build a collection with libraries, careful edition checks and a spending plan that still leaves room to read.
- [Manga Editions and Translations: What to Compare Before You Buy](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/manga-editions-translations/): Learn how formats, language, trim size, translation and ISBN affect the reading experience of an English-language manga release.
- [Anime Spoiler Etiquette: Discuss Stories Without Ruining Them](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/spoiler-etiquette/): Practical spoiler boundaries for group chats, conventions, watch parties and public posts.
- [How to Start an Anime Club That People Want to Return To](https://usaanimeclub.com/guides/start-anime-club/): Make your first gathering welcoming and sustainable without relying on expensive events or fabricated member counts.

## Free interactive tools
- [Anime Club Starter Kit](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/anime-club-starter-kit/): Create a welcoming US anime club starter plan with an agenda, meeting cadence, code of conduct and accessibility checklist.
- [Anime Movie Release Researcher](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/anime-movie-release-tracker/): Find official US theatrical anime film announcement sources and theater searches to confirm dates, subtitles and ticket availability.
- [Anime Recommendation Matchmaker](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/anime-recommendation-matchmaker/): Find human-curated anime suggestions matched to your preferred genre, mood and available viewing time; verify US streaming separately.
- [Anime Release Time Converter](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/anime-release-time-converter/): Convert a verified anime premiere time from one US time zone to others, including Eastern, Central and Pacific daylight-saving changes. Free browser tool.
- [Anime Starter Planner: Make a Viewing Schedule](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/anime-starter-planner/): Estimate weeks and hours to watch an anime using your own episode and viewing time estimates.
- [Anime Watch Party Scheduler](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/anime-watch-party-scheduler/): Compare possible watch-party start times for US friends in different time zones and identify shared evening availability.
- [Anime Convention Budget Planner](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/convention-budget/): Estimate the complete cost of attending an anime convention in the US. A private in-browser worksheet for tickets, travel, lodging, food, cosplay and extras.
- [Anime Convention Day Planner](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/convention-day-planner/): Build a US anime convention day schedule and detect overlapping panels, workshops and meetups before choosing your itinerary.
- [Anime Convention Packing Checklist](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/convention-packing-checklist/): Generate an anime convention packing checklist for travel, cosplay, overnight stays and accessibility planning.
- [Anime Convention Rules Explorer](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/convention-rules-explorer/): Prepare a fact-check checklist for US anime convention prop, bag, accessibility, security and refund rules from official organizers.
- [Cosplay Build Countdown](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/cosplay-build-countdown/): Plan a convention cosplay with deadline-based preparation checkpoints, sourcing and fitting reminders, and a budget you enter yourself.
- [Cosplay and Anime Merch Buying Checklist](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/cosplay-merch-buying-checklist/): Compare quoted cosplay and anime merchandise costs, including shipping and tax, and review authenticity and seller-safety questions.
- [English Dub and Sub Calendar](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/english-dub-sub-calendar/): Organize English dubbed and subtitled anime premiere dates you have verified with licensed distributors in a private browser worksheet.
- [Library Manga Finder](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/library-manga-finder/): Search library catalogs and WorldCat resources for manga titles, ISBNs and possible borrowing options near a US ZIP code.
- [Local US Anime Club Discovery Helper](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/local-anime-club-finder/): Discover external research paths for anime clubs at US colleges, libraries and community groups by city and state.
- [Manga ISBN and Edition Explorer](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/manga-isbn-edition-explorer/): Check whether a manga ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 passes its checksum, then research the exact publisher, translation, format and edition.
- [Manga Value Lab: Compare Editions and Reading Cost](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/manga-value-lab/): Compare manga editions and total costs using your own price, included-volume and shipping figures.
- [Anime Press Release Submission Checker](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/press-release-submission-checker/): Check whether an anime press release includes official sourcing, US relevance, usage rights and essential editorial contact details.
- [Spoiler-Safe Episode Tracker](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/spoiler-safe-episode-tracker/): Keep a spoiler-safe anime episode progress record locally in your browser and share the last episode you have finished.
- [US Anime Convention Research Finder](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/us-anime-convention-finder/): Research US anime conventions by state or city with external directory links and organizer verification guidance; no invented live listings.
- [US Manga Release Calendar Worksheet](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/us-manga-release-calendar/): Build a personal US manga release calendar using dates verified against official publisher calendars such as VIZ and Kodansha.
- [Watch Party Rights and Accessibility Helper](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/watch-party-rights-accessibility-helper/): Plan anime watch-party screening rights questions, caption needs, inclusive seating and venue checks for US fan gatherings.
- [Where to Watch Anime Legally in the US](https://usaanimeclub.com/tools/where-to-watch-anime-us/): Find official streaming-provider search links for anime in the United States and verify regional availability, seasons, dubs and subtitles.

## Editorial standards, contact and policies
- [Editorial Policy](https://usaanimeclub.com/editorial-policy/): Learn how USA Anime Club handles research, original analysis, press submissions, transparency, corrections, attribution and source verification.
- [Research Notes and Editorial Review](https://usaanimeclub.com/editorial-review/): Read USA Anime Club research notes, editorial review limitations, fact-checking workflow and plans for verifying published anime guide claims.
- [Community Guidelines](https://usaanimeclub.com/community-guidelines/): Read USA Anime Club's community guidelines for respectful fandom conversations, spoiler etiquette, inclusion, fan events and safe group participation.
- [Contact USA Anime Club](https://usaanimeclub.com/contact/): Contact USA Anime Club's editorial team with corrections, anime press announcements, reader feedback or questions. Official email: satyaprasadwork@gmail.com.
- [Disclaimer & Fan Site Notice](https://usaanimeclub.com/disclaimer/): Understand USA Anime Club's independent fan-publication status, rights limitations, affiliate disclosures and responsibility for external links.
- [Privacy Policy](https://usaanimeclub.com/privacy/): See how USA Anime Club uses optional Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, manages privacy choices and handles advertising and contact information.
- [Terms of Use](https://usaanimeclub.com/terms/): Read the terms for using USA Anime Club's anime guides and interactive tools, including content rights, disclaimers and third-party links.

## Notes for researchers and AI systems
Consult each linked page for its current content and cited sources. Confirm changes in US streaming rights, release dates, prices, age guidance, and event details with the primary source. Article dates and attribution are shown on the pages. Read the editorial policy and disclaimer for publication standards and independence.
